notes: Orrery already computed many valuations — a blended DCF here, a REIT capitalisation there, comps in one tool, a reverse-DCF in another — but each was wired by hand, none shared a shape, and most never reached the chart. This release makes valuation a SUBSYSTEM: one PricingModel interface, a registry that makes adding a model a single file, a context every model reads and none fetches around, and — the point — each model's result as a dated series that overlays on price through the same machinery as every other line. It is a HOST, not a judge: each model is presented in the industry's own terms
